latest_release.name: 3.2.0-alpha08
latest_release.body:
### Kernel

- Overwriting property with same value no longer generates write command [\#9056](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9056)
- More scalable index logging [\#9063](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9063)
- Allow skip bad entries logging during import [\#9103](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9103)

### Cypher

- Improved cypher execution speed on variable length queries where only the distinct pairs of start and end node are of interest. One query to benefit would be `MATCH (a)-[*4..5]->(b) RETURN DISTINCT a, b`. [\#9062](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9062)
- Allow more granular configuration of literals extraction [\#9093](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9093)
- It is no longer possible to CREATE or DROP composite uniqueness constraints. To enforce composite uniqueness, we refer to the new NODE KEY constraint. [\#9135](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9135)
- Use getDegree instead of expansion [\#9139](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9139)
- Correct query type for procedures [\#9143](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9143)
- Handle Ands with single value [\#9149](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9149)
- Predicates on shortest path and optional match [\#9156](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9156)

### Packaging

- Removed `neo4j-shared.sh`. Functionality is now included in all wrapper scripts directly [\#9083](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9083)

### Security

- Added new role `Editor` that is allowed to read and write data but not allowed to create new tokens. [\#9081](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9081)

### Causal Clustering

- Improve transaction streaming [\#9070](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9070)

### Tools

- Added `--version` argument to `neo4j-admin` and `neo4j` commands [\#9102](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9102)
- Renamed `neo4j-admin version` to `neo4j-admin store-info` [\#9126](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9126)

### Misc

- Show allocated memory and page hits/faults in `dbms.listQueries` [\#9037](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9037)
- Neo4j now exits with code 0 for SIGINT and SIGTERM [\#9108](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j/pull/9108)

    
    - systemd will no longer report neo4j as `failed` after you do `systemctl stop neo4j`.
    - Hitting Ctrl-C when running `neo4j console` will no longer exit with error if shutdown was performed gracefully.
